previousFindingsConfirmed.evidence: Decision 6 (lines 166-183) now mandates exec.subscriberId == resolvedSubscriber.id AND exec.projectId == projectId before advancing, AND resumeOnCallback CAS scoped by subscriberId (predicate: _id == execId AND subscriberId == sub.id AND status==waiting_for_reply AND stepRunStatus==pending) — authorization enforced atomically at DB layer, race-safe. Rationale explicitly names the threat (ObjectId partially predictable, not a secret). Propagated consistently to Task 3 (resumeOnCallback signature now (executionId, subscriberId, targetStepId), subscriberId-scoped CAS), Task 5 (explicit owner-authorization step), Risks table (dedicated IDOR row + IDOR-IT), AC line 374, and two integration test scenarios (lines 302-303: forged executionId rejected, execution B does not advance).

Decision 6 (lines 175-177) now requires ObjectId-hex shape check (24 hex chars) BEFORE DB lookup, non-negative bounded index, exactly one ':' delimiter (extra segments rejected), and callback-type-only button. Mirrored in Task 5 (lines 442-443). Unit test for malformed/oversized -> no-op (line 287); test scenarios for out-of-range / url-button index / snapshot mismatch (line 304).

Decision 10 (lines 214-217) now requires URI parse, scheme exactly 'http'|'https' (explicitly not startsWith), non-empty host; explicit reject of javascript:/data:/tg:///whitespace-obfuscated -> 422. Propagated to Task 4 (line 426 strict URI scheme parse + non-empty host), Risks (line 353), AC (line 376).

Decision 9 (lines 205-207) now states events (funnel_button_clicked, telegram_callback_query) carry only ids/codes, explicitly no from.first_name/username (per Phase-1 Decision 16). Task 5 (line 446) reiterates 'лише ids'.
Task 6 (lines 460-461) now mandates button/label rendering via text interpolation, explicitly NOT v-html.

findings.issue: answerCallbackQuery(botId, callbackQueryId, text?) is specified to be called on every path including no-op (Decision 6/8, Task 2/5). The spec does not explicitly pin that the optional `text` ack string is server-side-constant and never derived from attacker-controlled callback_data. Read holistically the text is a static no-op ack (not echoed user input), so no injection vector exists at spec level.
findings.recommendation: No action required at spec level. Implementer should keep answerCallbackQuery `text` server-sourced/static and never interpolate callback_data or other untrusted input into it. Token-scrub on the outbound path (already required in Task 2) covers the logging side.
